name: nablaDFT
description: Large-scale benchmark and dataset for conformational energy and Hamiltonian prediction derived from density functional theory calculations.
reputation: A specialized, recently introduced dataset gaining attention in computational materials and molecular ML communities for large-scale DFT-derived energy and Hamiltonian prediction.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark derived from DFT; large-scale and compute-intensive ground truth generation; possible overlap/contamination with other public quantum chemistry datasets; metrics are regression-based (energy/Hamiltonian errors) and may depend strongly on conformer sampling and basis/functional choices.
